citation_validation.answer_text: Tooth decay starts when the pH of the mouth is lower than 5.5. The pH value in the mouth that leads to tooth decay is below 5.5. Tooth enamel, made of calcium phosphate, is corroded when the pH in the mouth is below 5.5. Bacteria in the mouth produce acids that lower the pH, leading to tooth decay. Using tooth pastes that are basic can neutralize excess acid and prevent tooth decay.
